verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents a RESTful API for processing applicant data and documents, plus an official MCP server that lets AI agents perform Sumsub operations with access scoped by existing role permissions. Together these cover the core of agent-operated verification with scoped credentials. However, the pack never specifically documents the individual operations the story names, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: explicit documentation of session/applicant creation, outcome polling, extracted-data retrieval and re-check triggering via API/MCP, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate the verification pipeline — create sessions, poll outcomes, retrieve extracted data, and trigger re-checks through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials

citations.quote: Use the MCP server to let AI agents perform Sumsub operations on your behalf, while keeping access controlled by your existing Sumsub role permissions.
With the Sumsub API, you can process the applicant data and documents submitted for verification through simple RESTful APIs.
The Sumsub API lets you integrate identity verification directly into your product, giving you full control over the verification flow
Generate an access token to be passed to the WebSDK during initialization.
